_readme: The home gallery's Drinks tab (Preston, 6 Nov 2026: 'give drinks free images, and like Aiko matcha too'). Each photo is a free-library (CC0 or public-domain) picture of a drink TYPE, never of the product MEON sells: the caption names the type and the products in `drinks` are listed as text under it ('At MEON: ...'). No logos, cans, bottles or packaging in frame (Preston via BOSS, 4 Nov 2026: branded cans and bottles are other companies' packaging). Every name in `drinks` must match a drink in data/catalogue.json and every catalogue drink must sit in exactly one group; npm run build stops otherwise. Photo sources and licences: docs/credits.md, 'Drink photos from free libraries'. Alt text: data/photo-alts.json.
